game.name: Capcom Digital Collection (USA, Europe)
game.desc: Capcom Digital Collection is a boxed compilation for Xbox 360 featuring 8 games previously available on Xbox Live Arcade. The games in question are 1942: Joint Strike, Bionic Commando Rearmed 2, Final Fight Double Impact (including Magic Sword), Flock!, Rocketmen: Axis of Evil (including the It Came from Uranus expansion), Super Puzzle Fighter II Turbo HD Remix, Super Street Fighter II Turbo HD Remix and Wolf of the Battlefield: Commando 3.
